scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && cargo build -p wm-server && cd apps/wm-web && npx ng build
scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build packages/fjadra-wasm --target web --out-dir ../../apps/wm-web/src/assets/wasm && rm -f apps/wm-web/src/assets/wasm/.gitignore apps/wm-web/src/assets/wasm/package.json
scripts.test:cli: cargo test -p wm-core --test cli_test && cargo test -p wm-core --test mcp_test
